title: Red Hot Summer Tour at Mornington Racecourse: ticketholder guide
summary: The promoter marks Red Hot Summer Tour sold out. Entry times, transport and access information for existing ticketholders heading to Mornington Racecourse on Sunday 8 November.

editorNote:
The promoter lists general gates at 12.30pm, with Australian Crawl scheduled to finish at 9.30pm. These are Melbourne local times; the promoter may change the programme.

Australian Crawl and Men At Work lead the bill, alongside Birds of Tokyo, Vika & Linda, Eskimo Joe, Boom Crash Opera and Ella Hooper. Entry is strictly for adults aged 18 and over. Download your ticket before arrival and have it ready to scan.

The entrance is on Racecourse Road at 320 Racecourse Road, Mornington. The promoter warns of congestion and advises allowing at least an hour for entry and exit. Parking is limited and unreserved. Its event page links to shuttle information and identifies the drop-off and pick-up area beside the public car park.

The outdoor grounds have uneven surfaces. The promoter lists permit-holder parking, an accessible viewing area and nearby accessible toilets. Read its access and entry conditions before travelling, including the ban on picnic rugs and umbrellas. Watch for any event-change advice from the promoter.
